retirement_age.notes: Statutory pension age is 67 for both men and women (minimum 15 years of insurance). Retirement is possible from 62 with 40 years of contributions. By law, ages are reviewed every three years against life expectancy at 65; in February 2026 the Labour Ministry said no increase was expected for 2027 (reported by GreekReporter).
